spans.s:
Kuya-vāc (‘evil-speaking’) appears in one passage of the Rigveda to denote a demon slain by indra, probably as a personification of the barbarian opponents of the Āryans. The expression mṛdhra-vāc (‘speaking insultingly’) is similarly used of barbarians in the Rigveda.
Foot notes i. 174, 7.
v. 29, 10; 32, 8. See dasyu.
